title: QA Cum QC Executive
job_description:
Diploma or equivalent qualification in Food Science, Quality Control, Biotechnology, or related field Minimum 1–2 years of working experience in Quality Control / Quality Assurance, preferably in the food manufacturing industry Knowledge of GMP, HACCP, and food safety standards is an added advantage Responsible, hardworking, and willing to learn Good attention to detail and teamwork skills Able to follow instructions and maintain proper records Basic computer knowledge is an added advantage

Conduct quality inspections on raw materials, production processes, and finished products Ensure products comply with company quality and food safety standards Perform routine checking, sampling, and documentation recording Monitor cleanliness and hygiene practices in the production area Identify and report quality issues to the supervisor Assist in maintaining QA/QC records and related documentation Support internal audits and quality improvement activities Work closely with the production team to ensure product consistency and quality

collaborative and supportive work environment work-life balance comprehensive health and wellness benefits opportunities for professional development

Quality Assurance Quality Control Product Development Manufacturing Regulatory Compliance Documentation Auditing
